profile.text: Lena the Perfumer is from a renowned, well-off Minosian family, unfamiliar with the ways of the world. Her race prides themselves on their keen sense of smell, but hers is outstanding even among the Vulpo, giving Lena a special edge in the world of perfume making. She joined Rhodes Island through regular application channels, overseeing the 'Convalescent Garden' and providing assistance to operators as needed.
